videos.title: Ramon the Mexican
videos.description: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

videos.title: Viva! Django
videos.description: A cowboy runs into arms dealers while searching for the men who raped and killed his wife.

videos.title: And God Said to Cain
videos.description: President Grant's amnesty frees a gold-mine owner to hunt the bandits who framed him.

videos.title: Gentleman Killer
videos.description: A dapper stranger shoots schemers in a border town about to be declared U.S. or Mexican.

videos.title: Black Tigress
videos.description: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in the town of Sant'Anna with some other dancers. The town is terrorized by El Diablo, an outlaw who wants to sell the surrounding land to the railroad company. Lola helps the colonists rebel.

videos.title: Return of Shanghai Joe
videos.description: Shanghai Joe (Cheen Lie) and a friendly snake-oil salesman take on a sinister town boss (Klaus Kinski) who uses violence on those who oppose his demands.

videos.title: Requiescant
videos.description: The son of a Mexican bandit finds a village that is controlled by a former Confederate officer who steals from the locals.

videos.title: Professionals For A Massacre
videos.description: Three imprisoned soldiers agree to recover a cache of stolen Army gold in exchange for their freedom.

videos.title: His Name Was King
videos.description: A Westerner (Klaus Kinski) hunts the outlaws who have killed his brother and attacked his wife.

videos.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
videos.description: Seven masked bandits kidnap young Susy, who is the cousin of the mayor of Clayton City, and hold her for a $15,000 ransom.

videos.title: Run Man Run
videos.description: An unlucky thief makes a friend in prison and from there goes hunting for buried gold.

videos.title: My Name Is Pecos
videos.description: Bandits search for a barrel of loot hidden by a witness to a stagecoach robbery.

videos.title: Bad Man's River
videos.description: An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves.

videos.title: The White, the Yellow, and the Black
videos.description: In the 19th century, the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President, but it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians. Sheriff Gideon, assisted by a clumsy Japanese servant, steps up to deliver the ransom.

videos.title: My Gun is the Law
videos.description: In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad, until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town's respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

videos.title: Day After Tomorrow
videos.description: A man comes to Canyon City and becomes involved with two feuding factions after a bank clerk gets killed during a botched holdup.

videos.title: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
videos.description: While Cjamango is away from his farm, six bandits murder his family. Coming to terms with this tragedy, he sets out to avenge his loved ones.

videos.title: Seven Alone
videos.description: In the 1840s, the Sager family decides to brave the journey to Oregon in hopes of a better life. While traveling along the trail, their wagon train is attacked by natives, which results in the father's death. Shortly after, the family experiences another tragedy when the mother dies of pneumonia. When the wagon train leaders dismiss the seven orphans from the group, the oldest child, John (Stewart Petersen), decides to lead his brothers and sisters to the new life his parents wanted.

videos.title: Against a Crooked Sky
videos.description: When the eldest daughter of a family of settlers is captured by an American Indian warrior, her brother, Sam Sutter (Stewart Petersen), sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he encounters a wise, but alcoholic trapper named Russian (Richard Boone) who agrees to help him. The pair's journey into the remote Red Rock region of Utah is a perilous one, which ultimately brings them face to face with Chief Cut Tongue (Henry Wilcoxon), whose solution to the situation is a treacherous one.

videos.title: Last of the Renegades
videos.description: Old Shatterhand, Winnetou and Castlepool battle a ruthless oil baron trying to create a war between Native Americans and white settlers.

videos.title: Texas, Adiós
videos.description: A sheriff (Franco Nero) ventures into Mexico to find the crime boss who murdered his father.

videos.title: White Apache
videos.description: An Apache chief raises a white child as his own son.

videos.title: If You Meet Sartana Pray for Your Death
videos.description: Nobody knows a mysterious gunfighter who has joined a scramble for stagecoach gold.

videos.title: The Shooting
videos.description: In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.

videos.title: Sabata the Killer
videos.description: Bank robbers go on the run after a heist when the bank's manager hires a posse to track them down.

videos.title: Days Of Violence
videos.description: A man's brother is killed by an army man during the last months of the Civil War. To avenge his brother's death, he decides to join a group of Southerners determined to resist the army till the very end.

videos.title: Kill Django... Kill First
videos.description: A banker hires a band of outlaws to help secure a monopoly over gold mines, but Django's arrival ruins his plans.

videos.title: Death on a High Mountain
videos.description: An important robbery goes wrong as two young men find themselves standing in the way of Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman wanting their stolen loot back.

videos.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
videos.description: A man returns from the Civil War and discovers his father has been murdered by a greedy landowner. He vows revenge until he falls for the landowner's fiancée.

videos.title: Kill the Poker Player
videos.description: An undercover agent working in Lloyds of London investigates a robbery in which a thief killed his two partners to keep all the loot.

videos.title: Amongst Vultures
videos.description: Frontier vigilante Old Surehand (Stewart Granger) and his Apache warrior partner, Winnetou (Pierre Brice), clash repeatedly with the Vultures, a gang of ruthless outlaws who disguise themselves as Shoshone Indians when committing crimes. Surehand and Winnetou offer protection to Annie (Elke Sommer), who is carrying a valuable stash of diamonds -- but she's kidnapped when her loot attracts the Vultures. After the Shoshone are accused of the abduction, Surehand and Winnetou must sort out the mess.

videos.title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
videos.description: A young cowboy flees town after shooting a man over a rigged poker game.

videos.title: Dynamite Joe
videos.description: A government agent uses his talent for explosives to protect a U.S. gold shipment from marauding Comancheros.

videos.title: For a Book of Dollars
videos.description: Determined to retrieve their funds, a group of nuns and a gunfighter go after the thieves who robbed their mission.

videos.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
videos.description: Wells Fargo hires bounty hunters to protect its gold transports from notorious outlaw Glenn Kovac. Hired gunman Jeff Sullivan buys the freedom of Dan Barker, a prisoner who may lead him to Kovacs, but Barker escapes.

videos.title: Tequila
videos.description: Tequila and Bobo hit the little town of Chedron intending to rob the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to freeze out all the ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

videos.title: Django Challenges Sartana
videos.description: Django seeks vengeance after his brother is hanged for a bank robbery that he did not commit.

videos.title: Ben and Charlie
videos.description: Two likable bandits (George Eastman, Giuliano Gemma) try to make a living in the Old West.

videos.title: I Am Sartana Your Angel of Death
videos.description: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak.

videos.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
videos.description: The Pecos Kid (Ken Roberson) and a blonde (Laurene Landon) race a Mexican colonel (Luis Lorento) and renegades to gold guarded by Indians.

videos.title: Apache Fury
videos.description: A judge encounters a man he once wronged after an Apache attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

videos.title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
videos.description: A team of bandits carries out a big heist in a Texan village and subsequently runs away to a hideout. However, it is only a matter of time before the bandits get hunted down.

videos.title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
videos.description: The Blackie gang pulls off the perfect bank heist. It's unknown who took the money.
